description: Banco de España (Central de Balances) sector ratios for the company’s two-digit CNAE: sector benchmarking such as net margin, ROA and ROE. It is NOT the company’s own financial statements. `coverage_status` tells whether the sector is projected; when it is not, `metrics` is empty.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).
